pages.text: The Blueprint system has three parts:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Fabricator Block$() — Scans PreFabs and prints Blueprints $(li)$(bold)PreFab Blueprint Item$() — Stores scanned factory data (production rates, resource costs, NBT) $(li)$(bold)NBT-Aware Scanning$() — Data pack-driven system for tracking essential NBT fields

pages.title: Why Blueprints?
pages.text: Without Blueprints, every factory must be built by hand. Blueprints let you:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Duplicate factories$() — Scan a working factory, print exact copies $(li)$(bold)Share factories$() — Trade Blueprint items with other players $(li)$(bold)Archive designs$() — Store factory layouts as items $(li)$(bold)Scale production$() — Print multiple copies of proven designs
